entities.name: Scythians & Greek Colonies
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Scythian kingdom of the Pontic steppe: remarkable gold art (Pectoral from Tovsta Mohyla), kurgan burials, and interaction with Greek colonies (Olbia, Chersonesus, Panticapaeum) that brought Hellenistic culture to the northern Black Sea.
